info.description: Sign-up, sign-in, sessions and organizations are documented separately in the [authentication reference](/api/auth/reference).

apiKey.description: An API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <key>`

setupRequired.description: No user exists yet: whoever signs up first becomes the operator, whatever `signup` says

providers.description: OAuth account providers the operator has configured (client id and secret)

key.description: The secret; shown only in this response

serverUrl.description: For ICS accounts only the host: the URL is a secret

autoPublish.description: Newly discovered calendars are published enabled

timezone.description: IANA zone, when the provider names one

state.description: `gone`: removed by the provider or soft-deleted by the hosted calendar owner

expectedLatency.description: Seconds until changes are expected to show (the current poll interval)

SubscribeInfo.description: ICS paths and links contain the literal placeholder `{token}`: replace it with the ICS token returned by feed creation or `rotateFeedIcsToken` (base64url, so it needs no further escaping). The token itself is never returned here.

SubscribeLinks.description: One-click links that subscribe to the combined feed (`all.ics`)

calendarId.description: The Google calendar the sink writes

status.description: `calendar_missing`: the calendar was deleted in Google and the sink stopped; remove the sink, or remove and create it again

NeedsConsentProblem.description: `type` …/problems/needs-consent: send the browser to `authorizationUrl`, then create the sink again. Any other 409: the sink exists already

returnTo.description: Where Google sends the browser back after consent, when consent is needed

StreamEvent.description: One server-sent event: `event:` is `type` and `data:` is this JSON. Only `resources.changed` sets `id:`.

ResourcesChangedEvent.description: Events changed in these source calendars, up to `seq` (also the SSE `id:`)

AccountStatusEvent.description: A calendar account’s connection or sync status changed

FeedChangedEvent.description: A feed’s publications or credentials changed

ResetEvent.description: Changes cannot be replayed from `Last-Event-ID`: refetch everything
